@Entry
@Component
struct SettingsPage {
  @Builder
  settingRow(icon: string, title: string, value: string) {
    Row({ space: 12 }) {
      Text(icon)
        .fontSize(16)
        .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)
        .fontColor(Color.White)
        .textAlign(TextAlign.Center)
        .width(36)
        .height(36)
        .borderRadius(18)
        .backgroundColor('#4A90D9')

      Text(title)
        .fontSize(16)
        .fontColor('#1A1A1A')
        .layoutWeight(1)
        .maxLines(1)
        .textOverflow({ overflow: TextOverflow.Ellipsis })

      Text(value)
        .fontSize(14)
        .fontColor('#8A8A8A')
        .maxLines(1)
        .textOverflow({ overflow: TextOverflow.Ellipsis })
    }
    .width('100%')
    .height(56)
    .padding({ left: 16, right: 16 })
    .alignItems(VerticalAlign.Center)
  }

  build() {
    Column() {
      Text('Settings')
        .fontSize(24)
        .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)
        .fontColor('#1A1A1A')
        .width('100%')
        .padding({ left: 16, right: 16, top: 16, bottom: 16 })

      Column() {
        this.settingRow('W', 'Wi-Fi', 'Home')
        Divider().color('#E5E5E5').margin({ left: 64, right: 16 })
        this.settingRow('B', 'Bluetooth', 'On')
        Divider().color('#E5E5E5').margin({ left: 64, right: 16 })
        this.settingRow('L', 'Language', 'English')
        Divider().color('#E5E5E5').margin({ left: 64, right: 16 })
        this.settingRow('S', 'Storage', '12 GB free')
      }
      .width('100%')
      .backgroundColor(Color.White)
      .borderRadius(12)
      .margin({ left: 16, right: 16 })
    }
    .width('100%')
    .height('100%')
    .alignItems(HorizontalAlign.Start)
    .backgroundColor('#F2F3F5')
  }
}
